title: The Broken Salt
author: Astrid Okonkwo
blurb: Noor Winterbourne, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
